# sqlite-vec v0.1.9

Unmodified loadable libraries from [sqlite-vec v0.1.9](https://github.com/asg017/sqlite-vec/releases/tag/v0.1.9).
The [MIT license](LICENSE-MIT) comes from the same tag. The build hook checks
each extracted library's SHA-256 before staging it.
